news.title: Understand generative AI and AI agent announcements
news.intro: Follow model releases and AI agent news with a practical evidence check: what is available, what access is required and which claims still need verification.

jobs.title: Plan your AI career: skills, interviews and offers
jobs.intro: Use these guides alongside machine learning, data science and AI engineering listings. For remote or international roles, confirm permitted work location and eligibility directly with the employer.

podcasts.title: Learn from AI podcasts or create your own
podcasts.intro: Choose a listening goal, prepare accessible transcripts and measure podcast performance without confusing downloads with completed listening.

startups.title: Evaluate AI startup products, funding programmes and costs
startups.intro: Move from a product pitch to practical questions about customer value, accelerator terms and the cost of running an AI feature.

events.title: Prepare for AI conferences, workshops and hackathons
events.intro: Use the organiser listings to confirm dates and attendance. These original guides help speakers and organisers prepare proposals, accessible sessions and clear hackathon rules.

robotics.title: Compare robot demos, pilot projects and supplier quotes
robotics.intro: Explore humanoid robots, robot dogs and automation with evidence in view. Check operator involvement, the intended application and supplier responsibilities before a purchase decision.

tools.title: Evaluate AI agents, research tools and meeting assistants
tools.intro: Compare a tool on a real task before connecting repositories, uploading documents or recording meetings. Check access, source quality, privacy and human review requirements.
